name: Swagger UI
description: Generates interactive web documentation from an OpenAPI (Swagger) description of a web API, so users of a research service can read about and try out each of its operations.
featureList: Renders interactive API documentation from Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3 definitions
Lets users try out each API operation from the documentation page
Distributed as npm packages, static HTML/CSS/JS files and a Docker image
